deep.reconstruction:
This page has no mathematics: no derivations, formulas or computations. It is a dated (1826) reading or acquisition list of recently published books, the kind of memorandum entries found throughout this notebook (the previous page lists journal references and a note on Ertel theodolite screw threads; the next page continues the list with English travel literature from 1824–25). The entries, with likely identifications (mine):
(1) J. H. Bender, 'Der Verkehr mit Staatspapieren' (Göttingen, 1825), on dealing in government securities. Gauss was interested in finance and managed the Göttingen widows' fund.
(2) Krünitz, Oekonomisch-technologische Encyklopädie, vol. 141.
(3) J. J. Prechtl (ed.), Jahrbücher des polytechnischen Institutes in Wien, vols. 7, 8–15.
(4) G. H. Schubert, Vermischte Schriften, vol. 3 (?).
(5) J. N. Schwerz, Anleitung zum praktischen Ackerbau, vol. 4.
(6) G. Timkovski, Reise nach China (German translation, c. 1825–26).
(7) L. J. C. Mende, Ausführliches Handbuch der gerichtlichen Medizin, vols. 4–5.
(8) A. T. Kupffer, Preisschrift über genaue Messung der Winkel an Krystallen (1825).
(9) C. F. Naumann, Grundriss der Krystallographie (1826).
(10) A. Bauer, Entwurf eines Strafgesetzbuchs für das Königreich Hannover (1826).
(11) (Hering), Erinnerungen eines Legionärs, oder Nachrichten von den Zügen der Deutschen Legion in England, Irland, Dänemark etc. (1826).
(12) Historisch-topographisch-statistische Beschreibung der Stadt Halle.
(13) L. de Freycinet, Voyage autour du monde, volume 'Observations du pendule' (1826). This was relevant to Gauss's geodetic and figure-of-the-earth interests.
(14) Denham and Clapperton, Narrative of Travels and Discoveries in Northern and Central Africa in the years 1822–1824 (1826).
(15) W. E. Parry, Journal of a Third Voyage for the Discovery of a North-West Passage (1826).
(16) C. Waterton, Wanderings in South America (1825).
(17) F. Hall, Colombia: its present state (1824).
The items most connected to Gauss's scientific work are Kupffer and Naumann (crystallography) and Freycinet's pendulum observations (gravity and geodesy).

results.what: Bibliographic reading list of 1826 publications (finance, agriculture, forensic medicine, crystallography, law, travel, pendulum gravity observations)

deep.surprise_reason: The page is purely a book list with no mathematical content. It is only of minor interest as evidence of Gauss's reading in 1826, for example crystallography and Freycinet's pendulum results.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: 'Brandes[?]' should almost certainly read 'Bender' (J. H. Bender, 'Der Verkehr mit Staatspapieren', 1825). 'Staatspapieren' is confirmed.
'Schuberts vermischte Schriften Bd. 3[?]': the volume number is unclear in the image ('Bd. B'/'Bd. 3'); the work is G. H. Schubert's Vermischte Schriften.
'Mendes Handbuch der ger.: Medicin' refers to L. J. C. Mende's Handbuch der gerichtlichen Medizin; the manuscript has 'Mende's'.
'Statis{+t+}ische': Gauss wrote 'Statisische' and inserted the missing 't' above the line, so the intended word is 'Statistische'.
'Stadt Halle' is correct, though the word 'Stadt' is written somewhat overwritten.
